verdict.rationale: The evidence shows gstack ships a fixed bundle of about 23 opinionated skills, described in a static docs page (docs/skills.md). There is no evidence of a browsable or searchable registry, leaderboard, or marketplace of skills to explore before installing. The gitagent registry listing was a third-party user's republishing, not a gstack capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can browse or search a catalog of available skills — a registry, leaderboard, or marketplace listing — before installing anything
